label: Entailment
evidence: information disclosed by the Disclosing Party will be considered Confidential Information by the Receiving Party only if such information is conspicuously designated as "Confidential" (i) in writing, if communicated in writing, or (ii) confirmed in writing within ninety (90) days of disclosure, if disclosed orally or in other non-tangible form
reason: Information counts as Confidential Information only if it is conspicuously designated as Confidential, either in writing or by written confirmation after oral disclosure. So all Confidential Information has to be expressly identified.
